finops-professionals-agentic-ai-cost-ove.headline: FinOps Professionals - Agentic AI Cost Overruns
finops-professionals-agentic-ai-cost-ove.description:
Uber burned its entire 2026 AI budget in four months, and had to cut back on usage. Agentic AI cost just doesn't behave like traditional software that we know how to budget for.

I spent years at Apptio building the tooling that made cloud spend predictable, and that playbook doesn't survive contact with agents. Most teams are learning that lesson the hard way.

My new piece is on why agentic AI keeps blowing out of budget, and what makes it so hard to see coming.

Would like to hear from others how they are managing their AI costs.

#AgenticAI #FinOps #AI

amplemarket-growth-and-elite-customers-p.headline: Amplemarket Growth & Elite Customers - Pricing Credits & Duo Copilot
amplemarket-growth-and-elite-customers-p.description:
Amplemarket wants to replace your SDR stack with one AI copilot. Here's what a handful of users, reviewers, and industry personalities had to say about that\
\
I publish tool reviews on marketintelligencetools.com, and I just finished a long one on Amplemarket, which is a conflict when I'm the one asking for real opinions on it. I want to hear from people who've run real pipeline through it, especially anyone who came from Apollo, Outreach or Salesloft and can compare the switch directly.\
\
Amplemarket bundles a 200-million-contact database, outreach across seven channels and an AI copilot called Duo into one contract. The Startup plan is $600 a month for two seats, billed annually, with no monthly option and no published free trial anywhere on the site. Fifteen thousand email credits and 480 phone credits per user come with it, plus two mailboxes.\
\
Growth and Elite are both custom quotes, & neither publishes a number. Vendr's tracked-contract data puts the real median at $16,608 a year, ranging from $11,678 to $35,946. That's two to five times the advertised Startup rate, once a team needs the tiers Amplemarket won't price in public.\
\
Has anyone here signed a Growth or Elite contract? I'd like to know if the number landed near that $16,608 median, or somewhere past the $35,946 high end Vendr has on record.\
\
https://preview.redd.it/p0xzw646gxnh1.png?width=2400&format=png&auto=webp&s=7d148659bd39779f86d253cc6ad019939fb54b6e\
\
I pulled G2's own listing directly before posting this to make sure I get this right. Its aggregate is 4.6 out of 5 across 662 reviews as of 26 August 2026, with a 9.3-out-of-10 score for Quality of Support. Capterra's live listing matches on the headline number: 4.6 out of 5 across 7 reviews, 5.0 on customer service.\
\

technology-leaders-educators-students-pe.headline: Technology Leaders Educators Students - Percent of Role AI Could Do
technology-leaders-educators-students-pe.description:
🚨 AI WILL LIKELY RENDER WHAT I DO - AND WHAT YOU ASPIRE TO DO - OBSOLETE.\
\
That sounds uncomfortable.\
It is supposed to.\
But I am not predicting that software engineers, accountants, marketers, researchers, cybersecurity professionals or engineers will simply disappear.\
\
I am arguing something more important:\
👉 A significant portion of what these professionals do today is becoming automatable.\
And that could fundamentally rewrite the career ladder.\
\
For decades, professional progression broadly looked like:\
Learn → Execute → Gain Experience → Manage → Lead\
\
In the AI era, I believe it may increasingly become:\
Learn → AI-Augment → Automate → Integrate → Architect → Govern → Lead\
\
Why?\
Because when AI can write routine code, analyze datasets, prepare reports, generate content, summarize research, perform reconciliations and automate increasingly complex workflows, execution alone becomes less differentiated.\
\
The economic premium starts moving upward.\
💡 From coding → architecture\
💡 From reporting → interpretation\
💡 From content creation → insight\
💡 From manual analysis → decision intelligence\
💡 From operating processes → automating processes\
💡 From using AI → orchestrating AI\
💡 From technology execution → governance and leadership\
\
This has profound implications for professionals - and an even bigger implication for education.\
I don't believe we should tell the next generation:\
❌ Don't become an engineer.\
❌ Don't become an accountant.\
❌ Don't become a marketer.\
❌ Don't become a cybersecurity professional.\
\
Instead, we should tell them:\
✅ Become an engineer who understands AI.\
✅ Become an accountant who can leverage AI.\
✅ Become a cybersecurity professional who can secure and govern AI.\
✅ Become a marketer who combines AI-scale experimentation with human insight.\
✅ Become a leader capable of managing humans AND intelligent machines.\
\
And education needs to evolve accordingly.\
\
Perhaps the wrong question is:\
“Will AI take my job?”\
\
The better question is:\
“What must I become when AI can do much of what my job requires today?”\
That is the central argument of my new article:\
📖 “AI Will Likely Render What I Do - and What You Aspire to Do - Obsolete.”\
\
I would particularly like to hear from fellow technology leaders, educators, students and professionals:\
What percentage of your current role do you believe AI could perform within the next five years - 20%, 50%, 80%?\
\
And more importantly:\
What are you learning today to remain valuable tomorrow?\
\
#ArtificialIntelligence #FutureOfWork #GenerativeAI #AgenticAI #MachineLearning #FutureSkills #CareerTransformation #DigitalTransformation #AIEngineering #CyberSecurity #TechnologyLeadership #Leadership #Reskilling #Upskilling #FutureCareers #Education #DrNileshRoy #CyberSentinel
